EOI - Malawi - Project Manager - Systems Upgrade of MFI Hub and Natswitch - DFIC
05-Jun-2025
The services included under this activity are to carry out project management support for Systems Upgrade of MFI Hub and Natswitch in Malawi. The overall objective of this individual consultancy is to provide an effective project execution and management skills for the implementation of systems upgrade of the Micro Finance Transaction Hub and National Switch in Malawi.
